steps.label: Open Fees from the left menu
Every monthly invoice the academy issues appears in this list
steps.label_ur: اکیڈمی کے جاری کردہ تمام ماہانہ بل یہاں آتے ہیں

steps.label: Each invoice shows its status: Pending, Partially paid, Paid or Overdue
steps.optional_note: Requires at least one issued invoice on the demo account.
steps.label_ur: ہر بل کی حالت لکھی ہوتی ہے: باقی، جزوی، ادا شدہ یا مقررہ وقت گزر چکا

steps.label: Open the invoice to see the academy bank and wallet details
steps.optional_note: Requires at least one issued invoice on the demo account.
steps.label_ur: بل کھول کر اکیڈمی کے بینک اور والٹ کی تفصیل دیکھیں

steps.label: After paying, tap Upload Payment Proof and attach your slip
steps.optional_note: Requires an unpaid invoice on the demo account.
steps.label_ur: ادائیگی کے بعد Upload Payment Proof دبا کر رسید لگائیں
